This is the unmodified architecture-independent Sury package, retained here so removing an older core release cannot break builds.

- Package: `php-common`
- Version: `2:101+0~20261021.78+ubuntu22.04~1.gbp53f25f`
- Architecture: `all`
- SHA-256: `62bc3fbedea25bb92869c60085f094bcb68716e3ddb8c3128eb33a977f697a05`
- Retrieved from the previously installed [8.4.27 release asset](https://github.com/bilo1967/php8.x-ubuntu-legacy/releases/download/v8.4.27-focal.1/php-common_101%2B0.20261021.78%2Bubuntu22.04.1.gbp53f25f_all.deb); the SHA-256 matches GitHub's asset digest.
- Original Sury location: `https://packages.sury.org/php/pool/main/p/php-defaults/`

The Debian package retains its original copyright and license metadata in `/usr/share/doc/php-common/copyright`. No packaging or binary contents have been changed. Verify `SHA256SUMS` before use.
